summary: Refactored path containment checks in agent-server to use a shared `isPathWithin` helper and made the auth file permission assertion skip on Windows. Then relocated the `@gizmo/app` test suite from `src/` to a top-level `tests/` directory, updated `vite.config.ts` and `tsconfig.json` to include the new location, fixed stale relative imports, and added an `ImportMeta.main` declaration so the build script still type-checks.
decisions: Use the shared `isPathWithin` helper from `path-utils` in both `run-script.ts` (workspace containment check) and `extension-resources.ts` (declared directory containment check), replacing ad-hoc `startsWith`/`!==` checks so a single helper governs the rule.
Skip the `auth.json` mode 0o600 assertion on Windows (`process.platform === 'win32'`) since POSIX file mode bits are not meaningful there.
Move the entire `apps/app` test suite from under `src/` into a dedicated `tests/` directory so production source is not intermixed with tests.
Point `apps/app/vite.config.ts` at the new tests directory: `include: ['tests/**/*.test.ts']` and `setupFiles: ['./tests/setup.ts']`.
Expand `apps/app/tsconfig.json` `include` to also cover `scripts/**/*.ts`, `tests/**/*.ts`, and `tests/**/*.svelte` so the moved tests and build scripts type-check.

Add a local `ImportMeta { readonly main?: boolean }` declaration in `apps/app/src/vite-env.d.ts` so the Bun entry-point guard in `scripts/build-web-extension.ts` type-checks without pulling in Bun's own types.
errors: First edit to `pi-runtime-config.test.ts` failed because the `auth.json` mode check line appeared twice; resolved by including the preceding read assertion as context to make each block unique.

First edit to `session-repository.test.ts` failed with `Could not find edits[3]` due to a mismatched oldText block; resolved by re-reading the file and resubmitting a corrected batch, which applied all 4 replacements.

`pnpm --filter @gizmo/app check` failed with `Property 'main' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'` in `scripts/build-web-extension.ts`; resolved by adding an `ImportMeta` interface declaring `readonly main?: boolean` in `apps/app/src/vite-env.d.ts`, after which `svelte-check` reported 0 errors.
